info.title: Anyone Can Dock API
info.description: Docking tools with compound-name lookup, target-structure search, job submission/status, exact pose files, 3D viewer links and calculated contact data. Resolve names to structures before submitting a job. Metal proximities use the category Metal contact (distance-based; geometry not scored). Surface metal_warnings/warnings verbatim and describe metal_microstate_candidates as additional candidates alongside the pH-ranked selection.

get.summary: Check if the API server and tools are ready
Look up a compound name and return its SMILES string
get.description: Resolves a compound name through PubChem or built-in examples. Returns found, SMILES, source, CID and errors. prefer_builtin=false requests PubChem directly. Resolves ligand names before docking; does not perform docking or validate all identity ambiguity.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Compound or drug name, e.g. gefitinib

parameters.name: prefer_builtin
parameters.description: Use built-in example SMILES before PubChem lookup

get.summary: Search RCSB PDB for protein structures by name or target
get.description: Search RCSB by target/protein name and supplied organism or variant. Returns candidate PDB IDs and limited structural metadata. Start with top_n=3; relevance and identity matter more than resolution alone.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query, e.g. EGFR gefitinib or SARS-CoV-2 main protease

parameters.name: top_n
parameters.description: Maximum number of PDB entries to return

post.summary: Scan a PDB structure for HETATM residues (ligands, cofactors, metals)
post.description: Inspect non-protein residues in a supplied PDB structure. Returned keys identify reference ligands, cofactors and metals. A suitable bound reference ligand can guide the docking box; not every HETATM residue is a reference ligand.

Submit docking with a PDB ID or receptor text and resolved ligand SMILES or exact file contents. Compound names alone are insufficient. Returns job_id; inspect each ligand status via getDockingJob. Do not blindly repeat submission after an uncertain timeout.

get.summary: Get docking job status and result
get.description: Poll for queued, running, completed, or failed. A completed batch may contain failed ligands: inspect each result status and error. Return atom_mapping_url and checksum evidence when present. Preserve returned warnings and unavailable RMSD values. Metal contact distances describe proximity with geometry not scored.

name.title: Name
name.description: User-facing ligand label, unique within a batch. Does not resolve chemical identity or replace smiles/file contents.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: Ligand filename ending in .pdb, .sdf, .mol2, or .pdbqt; never a server path

file_content.title: File Content
file_content.description: Exact structure-file text; JSON escapes preserve newlines

file_content_base64.title: File Content Base64
file_content_base64.description: Base64 of original file bytes, recommended for exact PDBQT provenance

no_add_h.title: No Add H
no_add_h.description: For PDB: add no H and preserve existing H; direct PDBQT always bypasses preparation

LigandInput.title: LigandInput
LigandInput.description: Provide either nonempty smiles OR file_name and exactly one of file_content/file_content_base64. File names must end in .pdb, .sdf, .mol2, or .pdbqt. Never reconstruct or invent file bytes. no_add_h applies only to file input; for PDB it preserves existing hydrogens. Direct PDBQT bypasses all ligand preparation.

use_pubchem.title: Use Pubchem
use_pubchem.description: Use PubChem pKa/preparation evidence. This does not resolve ligand names; use getCompoundSmiles before submission.

replicate_seeds.description: Independent search seeds. One search by default on shared hosting.

DockRequest.title: DockRequest
DockRequest.description: Supply pdb_id or receptor_pdb_text, and at least one ligand. File inputs do not use protonation settings. Manual centering requires all three center coordinates; selection centering requires prody_sel.
